Opening names in vendor/chess-openings-2026-11/names.json and vendor/openings-popular-2026-11.json

Source: lichess-org/chess-openings, https://github.com/lichess-org/chess-openings
(commit 3ba6b20d31b2e6125cb0e6a2e792f400717d9d39, 5 November 2026).

"As a collection of facts, this data set is in the public domain." It is dedicated under

No rights are reserved; this note is a courtesy, not a requirement.

Kibitz keeps only the ECO codes and names of the positions that occur in its opening
lessons (tools/build-openings.js), keyed by position, and the names of the popular openings
shown in the Openings gallery (tools/build-popular.cjs).

vendor/openings-popular-2026-11.json: 35 openings for White and 33 for Black. The order is
ranked by hand by how often club players choose each opening in online games; it is a guide,
not a measurement. Every line was played with chess.js and named from chess-openings.

Kibitz is not affiliated with Lichess.
